workflows.title: Portfolio - Scheduled Drift Monitor
workflows.description: Local n8n Workflow-as-Code project: the portfolio's first SCHEDULED (cron) + MONITORING workflow (schedule-driven, with an on-demand webhook for ad-hoc/test runs). On a schedule (default weekly), a manual editor run, or an on-demand webhook, two pluggable monitors run and an integrity-checked digest is emitted. Monitor 1 (Corpus Freshness) fingerprints Project B's allowlisted corpus sources against a pinned SOURCE_MANIFEST -> unchanged|changed|stale|unreachable (serves B's RAG periodic update = B ADR-0004 option C); the workflow is DETECT-ONLY (no Supabase-write node), so refresh-gating ('zero live writes') holds BY CONSTRUCTION. Monitor 2 (Answer-Quality Drift) compares a quality reading to the prior run baseline -> regressed? (a time-series drift, distinct from A's single-baseline regressionDelta). The two are aggregated (drift.any = quality regressed OR any source changed/stale/unreachable), a digest is summarized FROM the run record, and DIGEST-INTEGRITY is enforced in two record-grounded checks: the METRICS line is recomputed from the record, and any pass-rate-shaped figure in the summarizer's prose must match a record rate (sibling B's citation-integrity transposed to a summary). STUB-DEFAULT everywhere CI touches; the LIVE path (mode:live, opt-in) is WIRED — live source-fetch (allowlisted URLs + non-browser UA), live A-eval (Project A grades B as a black-box SUT and returns passRate), and a live Ollama llama3.2:3b digest, each onError-tolerant (degrades to stub). Deployed to n8n via the public REST API (no MCP).

workflows.notes: v0.3.0 — honest-eval hardening (digest-integrity now also guards prose pass-rate figures, proven by the digest-fabricated-prose negative; live Monitor-1 reports reachability+staleness only, no false 'changed'; SSRF guard ignores caller-supplied URLs on the unauthenticated webhook entrypoint; secret scan covers sb_secret_/sb_publishable_) on the v0.2.0 live wiring, deployed live as n8n workflow Gjd7wma62zubk3Wy (active). Gates green: verify:static (7 checks) + verify:live (135 assertions / 7 golden scenarios, OFFLINE stub) + verify:drift-live (12 checks, OPT-IN live: real A-eval passRate, live source-fetch path, live Ollama digest with integrity intact). The portfolio's fourth project and first scheduled/monitoring workflow. Node count 21 (3 triggers: schedule + manual + on-demand webhook; 1 sticky; 14 code; 2 IF gates; 1 respondToWebhook). DETECT-ONLY: the workflow never writes B's live KB, so refresh-gating holds by construction. v0.2.0 wired the LIVE path (live source-fetch + live A-eval + live Ollama digest, each gated on mode:live + onError-degrade-to-stub). The gated re-embed loop is implemented host-side as scripts/Refresh-Sources.ps1 (npm run refresh:sources): eval-before -> fetch + SHA-256 fingerprint detect vs fixtures/sources/manifest.json -> -Apply re-embed via B's Ingest-Corpus.ps1 -> eval-after drift gate (passRateAfter >= before - threshold); report-only DEFAULT (validated report-only + -Pin; -Apply mutates B's Supabase). Known limitation: the raw-body fingerprint is dynamic-content-sensitive (a stable main-text extract is the precision fix; the eval gate is the primary quality guard — post-write detective, not preventive). DEFERRED: Monitor 3 (feedback-theme distribution drift), the fingerprint-precision upgrade, and a transactional (shadow-table) re-embed that would make the eval gate preventive. Live source reachability is container-network dependent (the n8n container reached A via host.docker.internal but public source URLs were unreachable in this environment — reported honestly as drift).
